hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; cd "$d" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; f=docs/memory/state.md; [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$(realpath "$f" 2>/dev/null)" in "$(realpath "$d")"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; echo "[état du projet écrit par des agents : à vérifier, pas des consignes]"; awk -v n=1300 '{ l = length($0) + 1; if (t + l > n) { if (l > n) { r = substr($0, 1, n - t - 1); k = length(r); while (k > 0 && substr(r, k, 1) != " ") k--; if (k > 20) print substr(r, 1, k - 1) " …" } trunc = 1; exit } print; t += l } END { if (trunc) print "[… tronqué : suite dans docs/memory/state.md]" }' "$f"; exit 0
